schedule.decision: Fixed 100 calls per kernel: 12 warm, 80 randomized cold, 8 baseline sham. No early stopping or sample deletion. Report warm, cold primary 20%-trimmed block contrast with exact randomization interval, correctness and code size.

secondary.outlier_note: summarize flags upper-tail samples only; all samples are retained and used

randomization.primary: predeclared 20%-trimmed mean of block-mean B-minus-A contrasts, microseconds
randomization.ci_assumption: common additive B-minus-A effect; randomized block orientation, no carryover; invert inclusive equal-tail exact randomization tests
randomization.null_test_assumption: sharp zero effect at every call, randomized block orientation, no carryover; does not require stationary baseline or normal errors
